Evan (PM): Quick sync: proposing a rolling-pin stability SLA + opt-in cutover playbook for major model transitions. Objective: minimize customer surprise, give customers control, and automate safe expiries. Short proposal below, want alignment.

Tara (SRE): +1. Key infra ask: per-tenant health checks, ability to throttle routing, and an emergency kill switch. Also need a written runbook for cache warmup/backfill.

Min (ML): Quality gates suggestion: stratified prompt pass >= 97%, mean embedding cosine >= 0.86, hallucination delta <= 0.75% abs. Sample sizes: default 3k, allow tenant override.

Keisha (CS): Customers expect notice windows. Recommend: 14-day pilot notice, opt-in preview, then 30-day deprecation notice for those who don’t opt-in. For enterprise: offer migration assistance and one-time credits.

Evan (PM): Draft playbook steps:
1) Silent validation (internal) 72h
2) Opt-in preview for tenants (hashed sample outputs) 7d
3) Progressive rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with gating on health metrics
4) Auto-expire pin for tenants that pass gates; manual follow-up for failures
5) SLA credit triggers and rollback budgeting

Tara (SRE): For rollback budget: track two auto-rollbacks/month per tenant; after that require manual approval. Also rate-limit backfill jobs to avoid cluster spikes.

Min (ML): Add nightly evaluation and a weekly regression digest. If embedding drift crosses threshold, trigger a hold. Also flag top-10 tenants for manual spot-checks.

Keisha (CS): Comms snippet: "We'll run a harmless preview and let you opt-in. If all checks pass, your pin will auto-expire; otherwise we'll propose migration steps and credits." Legal needs to approve credit language.

Evan (PM): Action items:
- Tara: add runbook + throttle controls by Wed
- Min: publish gate thresholds and eval harness by Tue
- Keisha: draft customer comms + credit tiers by Fri
Meeting Friday 10am to sign-off. If no objections I'll add to roadmap as a small initiative. :rocket:
